newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK TO GET RAUTARUUKKI KILN.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK TO GET RAUTARUUKKI KILN.

text.p: Finnish construction materials group Partek Oy Ab said in a statement on Friday it had agreed with steel group Rautaruukki to transfer Rautaruukki's Raahe lime burning kiln to Partek's Nordkalk subsidiary.
"Partek has agreed in principle with Rautaruukki regarding arrangements for the transfer of the latter's Raahe lime burning kiln to ... Nordkalk," Partek said.
The financial details of the transfer were not given.
The deal will "significantly increase" Nordkalk's lime burning capacity, it said, adding the Raahe facility is the biggest lime burning kiln in the Nordic countries.
"The majority of the production will continue to be delivered to Rautaruukki," Partek said. Nordkalk's limestone quarry in Gotland, Sweden will continue to deliver the raw material.
The arrangement was in line with Partek's strategy to "strengthen our limestone-based minerals operations in the Baltic Sea region and to create strategic alliances with our key customers," it said.
The deal will help both Partek and Rautaruukki focus on their respective core businesses, Partek said.
